name: CI&T Inc.
summary: CI&T Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides strategy, design, and software engineering services in North America, Europe, Latin America, Asia Pacific, and worldwide. It is also involved in the development of customizable software through the implementation of software solutions, including machine learning, artificial intelligence, data analytics, cloud migration, and mobility technologies.
